children: Aeternum Health announced agreements underpinning its expansion into critical minerals. The company will acquire all of American Renaissance Resources' interests in American Renaissance Minerals for up to 133,333,333 pre-split shares or pre-funded warrants, issued in stages upon milestones and subject to a beneficial ownership cap. ARM holds the right to acquire the Nkamouna nickel-cobalt project in Cameroon. In a related Investor Rights Agreement, ARR receives conditional board observer and registration rights tied to maintaining ownership above 9.9%, with specified termination triggers.

: Enter critical minerals via ARM and Nkamouna project option
Agreement 2: Aeternum Health Grants ARR Observer and Registration Rights Contingent on 9.9% Ownership
: Investor Rights Agreement with observer and registration rights
: Observer up to 15 months; registration until freely resellable
: Facilitate transaction with contingent governance and liquidity rights
